exact_post_result_lemma.consequence: For odd N, gcd(4,N)=1, so x-y and x+y are units mod N; normalized u=(x-y)/2 and v=(x+y)/2 form an exact inverse pair uv=1 mod N.
exact_post_result_lemma.boundary: Inverse-pair correctness does not imply smaller multiplicative order or earlier collision; the blind gate observed no such compression.

architecture_decision.retain: One shared JANUS Unified Factor Kernel with switchable exact operators and a single charged ledger.
architecture_decision.retire_as_successor: The specific epsilon=4 -> inverse pair -> unchanged small-step ORBIT transition.
architecture_decision.next_research_direction: Search for operator transitions that transform relation information into a demonstrably smaller quotient/subgroup/search space rather than merely changing the orbit base.
